texts.preamble: L.Mukthar Ahmed Another vs The State Of A.P. Another on 6 November, 2025 Aphc010045362009 In The High Court Of Andhra Pradesh At Amaravati [3560] (Special Original Jurisdiction) Thursday, The Sixth Day Of November Two Thousand And Twenty Five Present The Honourable Sri Justice Subhendu Samanta Criminal Revision Case No: 552/2009 Between: 1. L.Mukthar Ahmed & Another, S/O Mastan Sab, Manager V.B.S.Extraction & Regineries Pvt. Ltd., 17/702, Alur Road, Adoni, 2. V.B.S.Extraction & Regineries Pvt. Ltd.,, Rep. By Its Manager L.Mukthar Ahmed, 17/702, Alur Road, Adoni, Kurnool Dist. ... Petitioner(S) And 1. The State Of A P Another, Rep. By The Public Prosecutor, High Court Of A.P., Hyderabad. 2. The Food Inspector, Division - Ii, Guntur Dist. ...Respondent(S): Revision filed under Section 397/401 of CrPC praying that in the circumstances stated in the affidavit filed in support of the CriminalRevisionCase, the High Court may be pleased toto allow the Crl.R.C., by setting-aside the Judgment passed in Crl.A.No.120 of 2008, dated 31.03.09 on the file of the Iv Addl. Dist. & Sessions Judge, Guntur, confirming the conviction and sentence imposed in C.C.No.478 of 2002, dated 31.03.08 on the file of the Iv Addl. Junior Civil Judge, Guntur and consequently acquit the petitioners. Ss,J Ia No: 1 Of 2009(Crlrcmp 734 Of 2009 Petition under Section 151 Cpc praying that in the circumstances stated in the affidavit filed in support of the petition, the High Court may be pleased to enlarge the petitioners herein on bail by suspending the sentence of imprisonment imposed in in C.C.No.478 of 2002, dated 31.03.08 on the file of the Iv Addl. Junior Civil Judge, Guntur as L.Mukthar Ahmed Another vs The State Of A.P. Another on 6 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/8672898/ 1 confirmed in Crl.A.No.120 of 2008, dated 31.03.09 on the file of the Iv Addl. Dist. & Sessions Judge, Guntur, pending disposal of the Crl.R.C. Counsel for the Petitioner(S): 1. J Janakirami Reddy Counsel for the Respondent(S): 1. Public Prosecutor (Ap) Ss,J
texts.facts: During the pendency of the instant Criminal Revision, a Report was called for regarding the status of the petitioners. The Inspector of Police, Adoni II Town Police Station, has placed a Report. In the Report, it appears that the petitioner No.1 (A3) namely Sri Lohar Mukthair Ahmmed was expired on 20.05.2021. 5. The petitioner No.1/A3 being the Director of the private limited company and petitioner No.2/A4 being the juristic person i.e., a company, is not required to proceed further with this matter.
